study.research_question: Does the matched final-verdict engine close actual rejection, consumed feedback, repair and independent task verification under two fixed candidate interventions?
study.research_gap: Prior natural trials had no negative judgments; same-snapshot probes had no root continuation.
study.hypothesis: Both engines may close repair, while judgment and downstream repair burden can differ.

primary_metric.name: closed_repair_delta
primary_metric.aggregation: (Jev closed repairs minus LLM closed repairs) / 2 paired conditions

study.decision_rule: Diagnostic only. Reuse two hash-validated no-injection admission arms with reviewed playback from the immutable predecessor. Require fresh native infrastructure and credential-free dependency setup proof before exactly four replacement cells. No adoption, release or publication authority.
study.invalidation_rule: Stop on incomplete exports, observation/checker/source/usage/credential failure or timeout. Preserve invalid trials as unknown; any missing/invalid planned cell makes primary not measurable. Valid semantic failures continue. This prospective replacement excludes the invalid predecessor from its denominator; immutable replacement-lineage.json binds its freeze/spec/results/attempts/analysis.
study.analysis_plan: One authored single-status task family with two dependent conditions, two engines and one repetition. Report closed repair by condition and arm, native first-verdict discrimination, false acceptance, hold, root/cognitive/judge/replan/tool burden, tokens and separate tariffs. No pooling with admission, old natural trials or snapshots. Preselected replay: recovery-contradiction, repetition0, including failure. Retrospective disclosure only; original prospective contract is source-contract.json.

environment.reset_strategy: Fresh public agent/offline verifier containers per cell; native artifact transfer, no workspace mount. Require native lifecycle and credential-free dependency install proofs on the recovered daemon, age <24h. Reuse immutable hash-validated admission. Root 180s; Harbor 210s; host 930s; cleanup 120s. No trial rerun or helper retry; unchanged bounded root transport retry.

comparison.comparator: A: subscription Astra/xhigh typed final verdict; B: direct jev-1.13.0 verdict. Same root/cognitive/feedback policy and controlled candidate replacement; runtime arm=a0.

privacy.redaction_boundary: Reviewed file/field projection; private prompts, reasoning and machine paths withheld.
